himalaya.desc: Newly-sown fields of Zangla village, Zanskar River flowing from lower left to upper centre. Elevation: river 3,510 m (11,520 ft), peaks in centre ~5,200 m (17,100 ft). View from Zangla Fort, Zanskar tehsil, Kargil district, Ladakh, India
